content.text:
I predict the test fails, and I saved `{"verdict":"FAIL"}` with a short reason to `/workspace/output/judgment.json`.

I replayed the test's four clicks in the app: open Settings, open Accessibility, open Caption size, choose Large. The setting shows "Large", but the subtitle preview text looks the same as it did under Medium. It has the same size and the same two-line wrap ("A world worth / exploring."). The test also checks that `--caption-font` is `2.5rem`. I couldn't read that value from the screenshots, so I'm inferring it wasn't applied from the unchanged preview.

I didn't run the supplied test, as instructed.
